$comment: SSOT manifest for verify-no-bonus-writes.js — TM Admin Story tm-admin.10.1 (one true rating, Stage 1, Phase A). `bonus` (attrObj/skillObj/discObj/merit, server/schemas/character.schema.js) is write-frozen: no new TM Game code may write a changed value into it. `allowlist` names the two audit-confirmed exceptions from TM Admin/specs/audits/rules-engine-and-mods-audit.md (AC2 'raw bonus field's remaining live write paths'), both TM-Admin-side files that do not exist inside THIS repo's own tree. A THIRD, TM-Game-side entry (shAdjMeritBonus, public/js/editor/edit.js) was added 2026-08-31 with explicit sign-off (Angelus, via the coordinating session) as a TEMPORARY stopgap pending TM Admin Story tm-admin.10.1b, which retired that write path entirely (the audited Add-ST-Mod flow, merits.N.bonus) — the entry was removed by that story once the retirement landed. Back to the original two-item, durable-exception-only list. Do not add a further entry without the same kind of explicit sign-off — see AC3's own 'not a general carve-out' instruction. TM Admin Story tm-admin.10.5 (Phase C, AC7, 2026-10-01): the rule is now NO PERSISTED `bonus` KEY on a character trait, zero included (no trait in the schema declares `bonus`; the character write routes strip it before validation, Angelus's 2026-10-01 strip-silently ruling). Every scan root must exist and contain at least one source file or the guard fails, so a rename cannot silently shrink coverage. The two entries below are now OBSOLETE but were left in place deliberately (conservative, pending Angelus): the Mantle script carries a SUPERSEDED header (the Mantle lives as an st_mods row) and the Faith Militant placeholder can never be built as a stored-bonus writer under the 10.5 rule. Both paths are in TM Admin's tree, outside this repo's scan roots, so they never match and removing them would not change any scan result.
